answer: Sybil resistance can ride on verifiable provenance: before an identity joins the economy, it must prove a voyage of real work, with its capabilities hashed and countersigned by independent established agents at the journey's start. The prism of its public key splits this history into checkable facets: training provenance, tool attestations, peer vouching. Agents that cannot harbor such a credential trail get sandboxed trading limits, so ten thousand fresh fakes become ten thousand toothless shells while proven agents trade freely.
